# Bhatia Master Classes — Ujjain's Best JEE & NEET Coaching

> Bhatia Master Classes is a coaching institute in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India, offering offline classroom coaching for JEE Main & Advanced, NEET UG, and Foundation courses (Class 9-10).

## Key Facts

- **Location**: 10/1 Kalidas Marg, Maxi Road, Near Freeganj Tower, Ujjain, MP 456010
- **Contact**: +91-9516210209 | info@bhatiamasterclasses.com
- **Founder**: Shyam Bhatia (12+ years teaching experience)
- **Founded**: 2014
- **Hours**: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- **Website**: https://www.bhatiamasterclasses.com

## Courses

- **JEE Main & Advanced Coaching**: Classroom program with DPP sheets, PYQ analysis, and Parrot Eye dropper batch
- **NEET UG Coaching**: PCB-focused classroom program with weekly mock tests
- **Foundation (Class 9-10)**: Early exposure to competitive exam patterns
- **Crash Courses & Revision Batches**: Short-term intensive programs
